body.displayDescription: Tier 95 two-handed melee weapon with the native Igneous Showdown special and Ashen Vow passive.
body.mechanicalImplementation: Igneous Showdown designates and refreshes Flamebound Rival regardless of access source. Physical Ek-ZekKil owns Ashen Vow and the repeat/refund package; Ashen Vow is a cast-snapshotted 12% outgoing modifier against that target. Flamebound Rival has no timer in the single-primary-target model; death, revival, and genuine NPC phase replacement are not simulated.

reason: Correct Ek-ZekKil set membership and attach its native Igneous Showdown and physical Ashen Vow capabilities.
